prerequisites.experiment_10_partitions: Reuse the exact held-out-subject folds and deterministic personal test-window construction from Experiment 10.
prerequisites.feature_checkpoints: Reuse all 15 hash-validated Experiment 9 feature checkpoints without loading raw WESAD pickles.

research_question: When S2 and S4 remain uninformative after personal calibration, is the limiting mechanism calibration order statistics, subject baseline mismatch, a misleading sensor family, or the classifier representation?

rival_explanations.claim: S2/S4 ambiguity is mainly caused by the maximum-score conformal quantile used for 9 through 18 personal calibration examples.
Population-oriented features encode subject baselines more strongly than within-subject state changes.
One sensor family contributes subject-specific noise that damages state discrimination.
The shared-covariance linear LDA representation is too restrictive for subject-specific class geometry.

calibration_frontier.model: Experiment 9 regularized LDA on all 81 features
calibration_frontier.order_statistic_fact: At alpha=0.1 the threshold is the maximum calibration score through n=18; at n=19 it becomes the second-largest score.
calibration_frontier.support_rule: From k=18 to k=19, mean full-set frequency decreases by at least 0.03, mean coverage remains at least 0.88, and worst-subject coverage decreases by no more than 0.05.

subject_normalization.method: Per-subject median centering and IQR-to-robust-standard-deviation scaling.
subject_normalization.training_subject_statistics: Computed separately from each training subject's own training windows.
subject_normalization.held_out_subject_statistics: Computed only from the unlabeled onboarding pool, never from personal test windows.
subject_normalization.support_rule: Compared with lda_raw_all, improve mean accuracy and mean robustness loss by at least 0.03 each; targeted S2/S4 support additionally requires at least 0.10 accuracy improvement for both subjects and at least 0.10 mean full-set reduction while coverage remains at least 0.80.

families.ACC: ACC_X, ACC_Y, ACC_Z, and ACC_MAG features

sensor_ablation.support_rule: At least one single-family removal improves mean S2/S4 classifier accuracy by at least 0.10, reduces their mean robustness loss by at least 0.03, and decreases overall mean accuracy by no more than 0.03 versus lda_raw_all.

alternative_models.diagonal_qda: Class-specific diagonal Gaussian likelihood with 20% variance shrinkage toward unit variance.
alternative_models.distance_weighted_knn15: Fifteen-neighbor classifier in training-standardized feature space with inverse-distance weights and 0.5 class pseudocounts.
alternative_models.dependency_policy: NumPy-only deterministic implementations; no dependency installation or hyperparameter search.
alternative_models.support_rule: At least one alternative improves mean S2/S4 classifier accuracy by at least 0.10, reduces their mean full-set frequency by at least 0.10 while maintaining at least 0.80 coverage, and decreases overall mean accuracy by no more than 0.03 versus lda_raw_all.

continuity_validation: The k=9 and k=12 LDA frontier rows must exactly reproduce the corresponding Experiment 10 personal-calibration scientific metrics.
interpretation_guardrails: S2 and S4 remain post-selected exploratory cases.
A sensor ablation identifies predictive interference, not necessarily physical sensor malfunction.
Failure of the tested representations does not prove label ambiguity.
No literature novelty claim is made.
Coverage, accuracy, prediction-set size, and full-set frequency must be interpreted jointly.
